description:
`tests/fixture_matrix.rs` removes a fixture's leading comment/frontmatter lines from diagnostics reported against that fixture. Path headers are correctly gated by `self.canonical_source_name()`, but numeric source gutters are not.

`normalize_reported_source_lines` currently maps each line independently:

```text
let line = self.normalize_path_line_ref(line);
self.normalize_gutter_line_ref(&line)
```

`normalize_gutter_line_ref` treats every leading `<digits> |` as fixture-owned and passes it through `normalize_reported_line_number`, which subtracts `leading_comment_lines()`. Gutter lines carry no source identity, so this also renumbers snippets belonging to `runtime:` sources.

## Reproducer at pinned main

Direct compiler output for `enum_sort` is internally consistent:

```text
--> runtime:Enum.fz:437:3
437 | fnp split_sort_list(...)
```

The checked-in golden is not:

```text
--> runtime:Enum.fz:437:3
376 | fnp split_sort_list(...)
```

`enum_sort.fz` has 61 leading comment lines; runtime `Enum.fz:376` is blank. Adding one prose comment to the fixture changes the normalized foreign gutter from 376 to 375 while program output and the runtime diagnostic remain unchanged.

The matrix currently passes because it applies the same incorrect transformation to live diagnostics before comparing them with the incorrect golden.

## Fix

Make diagnostic source-line normalization snippet-aware:

- Track ownership from each diagnostic `--> <source>:<line>:<column>` header.
- Normalize a path line and its following numeric gutters only when that header names the fixture's canonical source.
- Preserve gutters for `runtime:` and every other foreign source.
- Continue canonical gutter-padding normalization independently of ownership.
- Cover interleaved fixture-owned and foreign snippets so ownership resets at each source header.

Add a focused static harness test using synthetic diagnostics and a temporary fixture with leading comments. It must prove fixture-owned headers/gutters both lose the fixture prefix; foreign headers/gutters retain exact line numbers; adding fixture prose cannot change a foreign snippet; and switching headers updates ownership.

## Affected goldens at a3a9761d

Re-bless the runtime-source gutters in these 8 sidecars:

- `enum_list_allocations.expected.diagnostics`
- `enum_map_family.expected.diagnostics`
- `enum_oracle_smoke.expected.diagnostics`
- `enum_sort.expected.diagnostics`
- `mailbox_closure_enum_hofs.expected.diagnostics`
- `map_enumerable.expected.diagnostics`
- `membership_operator.expected.diagnostics`
- `range_enumerable.expected.diagnostics`

For example, `enum_sort` gutters become 437 and 449, matching their headers and actual runtime source. Fixture-owned diagnostic goldens remain normalized.

Document in `.agent/docs/fixtures.md` that only fixture-owned diagnostic locations normalize away leading fixture comments; foreign-source locations retain true line numbers.

## Acceptance

- Focused normalization regression tests pass.
- Adding a leading comment to `enum_sort.fz` leaves normalized foreign diagnostic text byte-identical.
- All affected goldens cite real runtime source lines.
- Full fixture matrix passes.

comments.text: Fresh reproducer from the fz-kdt.183 build (2026-09-03, 2f4b6ebe0 on wt/kdt183-build): fixtures2/behavior/with_index_users_key_apart_by_element.fz carries a runtime:Enum.fz:320 diagnostic in its golden; adding four comment lines to the fixture header moved the golden gutter 296 -> 293 while the caret header kept saying runtime:Enum.fz:320. Same mechanism as this ticket (normalize_gutter_line_ref subtracts the fixture leading_comment_lines from a gutter that belongs to a runtime: source). The builder first read it as a renderer bug; it is the matrix normalisation. Any golden carrying a runtime-library excerpt is brittle against edits to its own header until this lands; fz-kdt.185 pins one such golden.

title: fixture_matrix renumbers gutters from foreign-source diagnostic snippets
